# custom_task (Resource)

Manages tasks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage example task.
resource "custom_task" "example" {
  title       = "Build custom terraform provider"
  description = "Develop and test a custom terraform provider"
  complete    = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String) Task title.

### Optional

- `complete` (Boolean) Task completion status.
- `description` (String) Task description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) String uuid identifier of the task.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Order can be imported by specifying the string uuid identifier.
terraform import custom_task.example 3f5b4d2e-8c12-4b8b-8cbb-3df2bcad50e5
```
